unit: A big conference for the American Cancer Society was held at the Marriott Hotel. As it often happens, many of the attendees lost various items by leaving them in the conference hall or in the corridors during the breaks. Luckily, the hotel had a lost-and-found service, which kept all the items. During the last day of the conference several people were standing in line at the lost-and-found office trying to locate their misplaced belongings.
A big sale event was happening at the car dealership last week. Several salesmen were helping many interested customers. In the afternoon several cars got sold.

A graduate student was writing a research paper for a class in psychology. In the introduction she wanted to summarize some important findings in the area of visual processing. She could recall most of the important results but often didn't know the researchers and the dates of the studies.

A group of local charities received many donations during a recent fund drive. Some people donated money, others brought in food, clothes, books and toys for children. The administrators of the charities sat down to write thank-you notes for the donors, but they realized that some donations didn't have the names of donors or receiving charities associated with them.

A marketing research company was conducting an analysis of how effective event sponsorship is. Specifically, they were interested in how much the sponsoring of sports events boosts the companies' profits. The intern who was hired to work on this project was told to compile a list of important sports events in the last five years and the names of the sponsors.
A non-profit debt consolidation firm was holding a seminar for people who had many debts to help them get control of their finances. At the first meeting, everybody introduced themselves.

An engineering company organized fun events for the employees every few months. At the end of each event there was a prize drawing. Prizes often included gift certificates for local restaurants, music CDs, and movie or theater tickets. This month there were two such events to celebrate the company's recent patent that got approved. However, the administrator who was responsible for distributing the prizes was away for the last few weeks, and when she came back and wanted to distribute the prizes from the last two events, she couldn't locate the forms, which listed the winners and the prizes.
Andrew had a literature test today at school. He had to know about the life of famous writers and about their literary works. During the test he got totally confused.
Around 4pm the house owner was sitting upstairs knitting. Suddenly a loud bang, followed by another one, came from downstairs.

At Christmas the employees of the company played a game of Secret Santa. Each employee brought a wrapped gift addressed to another employee and secretly placed it under the Christmas tree. At the party, everybody unwrapped their gifts.
At the end of each term the chemistry teacher often organized something fun for the students. He recently mentioned that he was planning something special this term.
At the end of the first match in the soccer game, some intense arguing was taking place after a failed goal attempt. It sounded as if the forward insulted someone on the other team.

At the timeshare sales office there were several interested customers. There were several sales associates giving presentations about the condos. At the end of the presentations, the sales associates were supposed to show each customer one of the available condos.

At the university, several professors and a group of graduate students were organizing a workshop. A professor from the physics department was in charge of the schedule. He had to invite some speakers from various universities, and he also had to ask the other professors to assign some papers to be presented by graduate students.
By the nutritionist's advice, the patient started taking several supplements with her meals. However, after a couple of weeks she noticed that she was feeling nauseous before bedtime.

Christina loved the impressionists and knew their art works very well. Sometimes, she played a game with her Mom where her Mom showed her postcards with the works of the impressionists and asked questions about them.

During the winter holidays, the fifth-grade teacher took the students on a trip to some historical places in Boston. When they came back to school, several students realized that they were missing hats, scarves and gloves.

Each student in a psychology class had to make a short presentation at some point in the semester. The professor was sick for a few weeks, and another professor was substituting for him. However, the substitute professor forgot to write down the presentations that took place in each class.

Early in the morning a bunch of police cars surrounded the apartment building on Church Street. Many residents came out of their apartments and some were talking of a murder that apparently took place a couple of hours ago.

For Christmas, the parents of children attending kindergarten were planning a party where one of the fathers would dress as Santa Claus and would give out the presents to the kids. All the parents told him about the presents their children wanted and about the kinds of presents they promised the children Santa Claus would bring.

Grandmother took little Timmy to the Science museum. One hall contained a variety of inventions by various engineers from the last three centuries. Little Timmy was four and couldn't read very well yet.

In the suburbs of Boston a lot of new buildings were being built by different construction companies. Some of the buildings were large apartment complexes built for various real estate companies. Other buildings were supposed to house various administrative offices. Yet other buildings were built for commercial purposes for various local and international companies. The city administration recently lost some of the records.

It was a busy day at the fancy restaurant. All the tables were taken and several parties were waiting in line. At some point, because of the unusually high workload, several waiters messed up the orders.

It was the end of the semester at the culinary school and the final grades were due soon. In the French cuisine class the way the instructor was evaluating students' work was by having each student bring a French dish they prepared on a particular date. This way, at the beginning of each class there was a little food tasting session where the instructor and the students in the class evaluated the dish on several dimensions. The instructor didn't take careful notes throughout the semester, hoping that his memory would serve him well, but when the time came to assign the grades, he had a hard time.

Jessica has three sisters. They like to borrow each other's clothes. Yesterday, when Jessica was doing laundry, she noticed that a few of her dresses were missing. She remembered that her sisters borrowed some of them some time ago.

Peter was moving to a new bigger apartment in the same building and he asked some of his friends to help him carry furniture and boxes on Sunday. He had five people helping him and it took them about five hours to move everything. When everything was moved, Peter noticed that one chair and a small bookshelf were nowhere to be found.

Several doctors were working today in the cardiology department. It was a busy day and each doctor saw many patients. The doctors prescribed different medications to different patients. However, the secretary was sloppy and got confused about all the different prescriptions.

Several new employees were hired last week at the medical devices factory. The job involved receiving new orders submitted through the company's website and mailing the ordered products to the customers. The new employees were not trained properly, and so they did not keep track of all the orders that came in and that they mailed out.
Some architecture students at the local school of design were taking a tour of the city. They visited many different areas and saw many interesting buildings designed by famous architects.

Some kids in a pre-school class were learning to read out loud. The previous day, the teacher broke the kids down into pairs, gave each pair a book, and then had one of the kids read to the other from the book. Today, the teacher wanted to reverse the roles.
Someone kept calling at the newsroom, and leaving long convoluted messages for a particular journalist. The messages made no sense whatsoever.

The Jones family recently asked to be put on the no-call list because they were getting way too many unsolicited phone calls. However, they were told it would take a while for the calls to stop. Last night during dinner, the phone rang, and it was a telemarketer again.

The accountant was not a very honest man and has been cheating his clients for many years. Recently, however, he was working with someone who turned out to be a major figure in the criminal world. This morning the accountant got a threatening letter.

The annual neuroscience conference had an online abstract submission form. Everything was working smoothly until the very last day when due to a large number of people using the website, something went wrong and for several abstracts the information about the authors and also the time-stamp of the submission got lost.
The athlete recently had an ankle injury. He was lucky not to require a surgery but he was told that he would suffer from pretty intense pain for a while.

The bikini model has always led a healthy lifestyle, eating well and working out almost every day. Recently, however, she noticed that she started getting heavier although nothing has changed in her life style.

The car salesman went to a party last night and was very hung over this morning. He talked to a few people around 10-11am and promised one of them a great deal on the Subaru. By lunch time, however, all the morning encounters were blurry in his memory.

The cashier was counting the money at the end of the day and was surprised to see that a few hundred dollars were missing. He wanted to ask the salesman about whether he knew anything about the missing money, but he couldn't find him.

The chemist was preparing to conduct a new experiment. He prepared all the necessary chemicals and beakers. His lab assistant was supposed to come soon and help him in carrying out the experiment. The chemist could not find the lab notebook with the notes on the experiment, which was conducted last week.

The cook was preparing a big dinner. He already started making mushroom soup and prepared the dough for the fruit-pie. For the main course, he was planning to prepare meat with rice. He cleaned the meat and cut it into cubes. Then, he wanted to soak the rice, but he couldn't find it.

The detective was interrogating several people who were drinking at the local Irish pub on Friday night. That night a lady who was sitting at the bar for a couple of hours drinking martinis disappeared.
The experienced scuba diver was doing a long dive and his flashlight started malfunctioning. Suddenly, something big swam right near him but then disappeared.

The farmer enjoyed growing oversized vegetables and won many prizes at the local fair over the years. This year, he had several prize-worthy vegetables, but only one submission per person was allowed.
The fitness instructor developed several new routines and was still trying them out to make sure they were appropriate for the fitness levels of his various classes.

The forester went mushroom picking. He found many different kinds of mushrooms. He also found an interesting mushroom, which he had never seen before. When he got home, he took out his big mushroom guide and tried to identify this mushroom.

The gardener was planting some flowers around the house. He already planted some tulips, roses and poppies. The poppies were very beautiful with unusual petals. A neighbor was walking by and commented on the beauty of the poppies. She asked the gardener about the specific kind of poppies, but he could not remember its name.
The general was getting ready for an attack. He called the officers to ask them about the condition of the troops. He also called the scouts to find out the positions of the enemy.

The geology department needed someone to teach an introductory class because two professors were on sabbaticals this year. One of the professors recommended a lecturer who once taught something at the department and got horrible ratings from the students and generally seemed like he didn't know what he was doing.

The head surgeon received a complaint about a new lab assistant who he hadn't yet met. Many doctors noted that she was not very careful. The surgeon was pretty sure that the assistant was just recently helping the pathologist.
The lead dancer in a modern ballet company always got along great with the choreographer. However, she recently noticed that the choreographer seemed really irritable and often sounded frustrated.

The owner of a bicycle rental shop hired three assistants for the summer, because he was having an unusually high number of customers. On the first day of work, the assistants rented out many bikes, but they didn't keep careful records of the transactions.
The recent controversial murder case has been causing much attention in the media. The defense lawyer was one of the best in the country and was known to bring in amazing expert witnesses.
The seamstress was making a dress for a client. She had beautiful silk fabric with an unusual pattern on it. She already took all the measurements and was preparing to cut the fabric.
The shepherd took the sheep to a pasture and sat down for a snack. After lunch, he fell asleep. When we woke up, he couldn't find several sheep.
The students got their grades today, and one of them was very unhappy. Specifically, he was surprised with his grade in math. He noticed that he got a bad grade on the last test.

The students in the 6th grade went on a day trip to the New England Aquarium. At the end of the tour everybody rushed to the gift shop to buy some souvenirs. Some of the students didn't bring any money and had to borrow from their friends. However, later, some of the kids were confused about who borrowed money from them or from whom they borrowed money.

The trainer was rehearsing a new trick with the tigers. The animals were behaving very strange today: they did not perform the commands and couldn't stay in one place. The trainer got upset because the day before the trick was already in pretty good shape.

The undergraduate student advisor in the Biology department was keeping track of which classes the biology majors took each semester. The department recently relocated to a new building and some of the files got lost.

There was a bad multi-car accident downtown last night. Several people were badly injured. The policeman talked to everyone involved, but the stories were not consistent. He noticed that cab driver was behaving strangely, sweating a lot and talking too fast.

William was the host of the talent show US Idol. The contestants came from all over the country to try out for the show. One of the contest rules was that the contestants did not know what they were going to sing until the very last moment and also the order in which they would have to perform.
